reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for caffeine pills, and that goes for any supplement or medication. In general, caffeine is a well-studied performance aid for endurance, but how much is too much depends on your body, your heart, any medications you take, and how you react to it. A doctor or dietitian can give you a number that's right for you.

The one coaching rule I'll push hard is that race morning is not the day to try anything new. If you do use caffeine, test it in a long run or a hard workout first so you know how your stomach and nerves handle it.

If you tell me which race and when it is, I can talk through your taper and race-week routine.
